t: This is Hamilton Place, a side street off Piccadilly close to Hyde Park Corner, with origins in the 1660s. It's the birthplace of John Montagu Douglas Scott, the 7th Duke of Buccleuch. He was a British Member of Parliament and a peer, and he was the father of Princess Alice, Duchess of Gloucester. Before inheriting the dukedom he was styled Earl of Dalkeith. It's a short street, but it gives you a glimpse of the aristocratic world that once lived around here.
